title: Fiordilatte Creamy Rice Pudding with Algerian Flair
description: A rich and creamy rice pudding infused with the warmth of Algerian spices, topped with a lightly aerated whipped cream.
instructions: Combine rice, fiordilatte milk, sugar, and Algerian spice blend in a saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes or until the rice is tender.
Remove from heat, stir in salted butter, and let cool slightly.
Transfer the pudding to individual serving cups.
Top each serving with lightly aerated whipped cream.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving.
